summary: The native 240 Hz baseline reconciled all 1,436 positive pair-force samples and confirmed sustained two-rib support, but the frozen ±5°/1 Hz drive produced no physical support loss or crossing. The probe now supports an explicitly labeled, non-qualifying ±8° excitation-amendment test while preserving 5°/1 Hz defaults. It records actual drive parameters, native contacts, support loss, moving-frame crossing, and whether the run matches the frozen baseline. Syntax compilation passed; GPU results remain unknown pending trusted-controller execution.
